# Welcome Students Group

> Registered education & migration agency helping students and skilled professionals live, study and work in Australia, New Zealand & Dubai for over 10 years.

Welcome Students Group is a registered education and migration agency founded in 2015, with offices in Brisbane and the Gold Coast (Queensland, Australia). It offers free educational advisory for international students, represents education institutions in Australia, New Zealand, Dubai, and provides migration guidance through registered migration agents and lawyers. Accreditations: QEAC, ISEAA, ICEF, English Australia, Australia Future Unlimited.

## Key facts
- Founded: 2015
- Destinations: Australia, New Zealand, Dubai
- Offices: Brisbane (Level 18, 324 Queen St, Brisbane City QLD 4000); Gold Coast (Level 9, Wyndham Building, 1 Corporate Ct, Bundall QLD 4217)
- Phone: +61 421 273 080 · WhatsApp: +61 404 315 695 · Email: info@welcomestudentsgroup.com.au
- Educational advisory is free for students (institutions cover the agency fee on enrolment).
- No visa outcome is guaranteed; applications are prepared with registered migration agents.
- Partner institutions include: TAFE Queensland, Southern Cross University, Griffith University, Langports, Impact English College, Lexis English, Kaplan Business School, Shafston College, Greenwich College, ILSC Education Group.

## Education programs
- English programs: General English, business English, English for academic purposes, exam prep (IELTS, Cambridge, TOEFL).
- Vocational courses (VET): Certificates, diplomas and advanced diplomas.
- Higher education: Undergraduate, master's and doctorate programs.

## Visa services
- Graduate visa: For students who complete a qualifying course in Australia.
- Work visa: For candidates with an employer able to sponsor them.
- Skills visa: Permanent-residency pathway based on your occupation.
- Partner visa: For genuine relationships with an Australian/NZ citizen or resident.
- Work & Holiday visa: Combine work and travel for eligible nationalities.
- Tourist visa: Short-term visits — including to plan your move.
- Family visa: Pathways to bring eligible family members with you.
- Cancellations & appeals: Representation for visa denials, including tribunal appeals.

## Destinations
- Australia: A world-class education system, unmatched quality of life, wide job opportunities and an enriching cultural diversity — our main hub, and where our team lives and studied too.
- New Zealand: Welcoming, safe communities with internationally recognised study options and post-study work pathways.
- Dubai: A global, multicultural hub with a growing international campus scene — a gateway between markets.

## FAQ
### Is your educational advisory really free?
Yes — our educational advisory service is free for students; institutions cover our fee once you enrol.

### Do you guarantee visa approval?
No agency can guarantee a visa outcome. We work with registered migration agents and lawyers to prepare the strongest possible application and reduce avoidable denials.

### Can I study English first and a degree later?
Yes — many students start with an English program (with exam prep for IELTS, Cambridge or TOEFL) before progressing to VET or higher education.

### Do you help with arrival — accommodation, bank account, phone?
Yes — airport pickup, an accommodation guide, help opening a bank account and getting a phone plan, plus TFN/ABN assistance once you arrive.

### I'm already in Australia — can you still help?
Yes — we also support people already in Australia who are exploring a study pathway toward migration.
